notes: v0.20.1 (code 71): Admin+ Theme Studio supports direct #RRGGBB hex entry for all editable UI channels and import/export of six-color VRChat UI palettes in the order Highlight, Icons, Buttons, Background, Fonts, Subtext. Accept comma-separated or line-separated codes; validate all six before atomically saving locally, keep sliders synchronized with hex and render a live color preview. Map icon, button, primary font, and subtext channels distinctly while deriving readable card, panel, input and border tones. Added copy-to-clipboard of the current theme in VRChat six-code format. All Admin+ staff can save up to 25 named personal palettes per Relay-verified Discord ID on this device, apply a stored preset, overwrite only with confirmation, or delete saved presets without changing the current colors. Importing VRChat codes does NOT automatically save a preset. Built-in themes remain unchanged; named presets are stored separately so choosing a built-in theme or resetting active colors cannot erase them. Previous 0.20.0 themes migrate without losing accent overrides. Royalty gold profile identity stays independent from a user's personal palette. Preserve StaffDex sourced exclusively from the official TGC roster, authenticated VRChat friendship checks, verified Admin+ gate, staff-facing What's New and fully Seawolf-attributed agreement 2026-10-14.2. In-place update only; no new permissions, data wipe, Main Launcher or Relay changes.
